parameters.name: ClientToken
parameters.description: A client token to ensure the idempotence of the request. Generate a unique value from your client for this parameter. The client token can contain only ASCII characters and cannot be longer than 64 characters. For more information, see [How to ensure idempotence](https://www.alibabacloud.com/help/en/ecs/developer-reference/how-to-ensure-idempotence).

parameters.name: ResourceServerIdentifier
parameters.description: The unique identifier of the resource server.
